title: Task 1: sourceInventory.ts pure inventory builder
description:
Objective: pure deterministic function building the source-structure inventory from PageText[].

Files:
- Create: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventory.ts
- Test: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventory.test.ts

API (in design field of parent eshyra-4a7.1; tier map there too):
export interface SourceInventoryItem { page: number; lineIndex: number; text: string; tier: 'chapter'|'section'|'subsection'|'leaf'|'sidebar'; structure: 'heading'|'table-caption'|'stat-block'|'table-shape'; section: string | null }
export function buildSourceInventory(pages: readonly PageText[], options?): readonly SourceInventoryItem[]

Steps (TDD, one commit per green):
1. Fixture PageText[] with lineHeights covering all tiers -> failing test asserting tier classification incl. h=10.0 legal lines EXCLUDED, h=10.8 sidebar INCLUDED. Implement tier bucketing. Commit.
2. Failing test: two adjacent h=12.0 lines in same column merge to one item ('Figurine of Wondrous' + 'Power'-style wrap). Implement merge. Commit.
3. Failing test: leaf heading followed by 'Large aberration, lawful evil' line classifies structure='stat-block'; followed by h=8.9 run classifies 'table-caption'. Implement. Commit.
4. Failing test: maximal h=8.9 run NOT preceded by leaf heading emits structure='table-shape' item attached to nearest preceding heading text. Implement. Commit.
5. Failing test: items carry containing section name using section anchor positions (reuse sections.ts slicing or pass section ranges in). Implement. Commit.
Command per step: npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventory.test.ts
